content: Caprolactam is an organic compound classified as a cyclic amide, also known as a lactam. Its primary industrial application is as a monomer in the production of nylon, specifically nylon-6. The majority of caprolactam is synthesized through the Beckmann rearrangement of cyclohexanone oxime. This compound is known to be an irritant and exhibits toxicity when ingested, inhaled, or absorbed through the skin.
